info.title: OpenAPI For SME Medical Insurance
info.description: API's that you need to use to request insurance(s) for your clients

post.description: You need to create a company record before requesting medical insurance to the employees of the company. On production, you register each unified national number once: creating a company you already registered answers 400 with code 40025 and the existing company_id, which you use instead. Sandbox allows registering the same company again, so you can re-run tests

unified_national_number.description: Unified national number of the company

start_date.description: Optional. The day the company wants its cover to start, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later. Issue Policy starts the policy on this day, or on the day it is issued once this day has passed. Left out, the policy starts the day it is issued.

400.description: Production only: this company is already registered under your account

message.example: This company is already registered as company 123. Use that company_id instead of creating it again.

422.description: Problem in the values that you submitted

message.example: The email address must be a valid email address. (and 1 more error)

email_address: The email address must be a valid email address.
sponsor_number: The sponsor number field cannot be empty.

get.description: To list all the companies that you've created

put.description: Changes a company you registered. Send only the fields to change; each follows the same rule as on Create company, and the employees and declarations are not touched. Once the company's policy is paid, the company can no longer be changed: the call answers 400 with code 40026 and that policy_id until the policy ends or is cancelled. A policy that is waiting for payment does not stop a change. On production, a unified national number that belongs to another of your companies answers 400 with code 40025 and that company_id.

unified_national_number.description: Unified national number of the company

start_date.description: The day the company wants its cover to start, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later. Send null to clear it, so the policy starts the day it is issued. A policy waiting for payment takes the new day when it is issued again.

200.description: The company as it is now

400.description: `40026` when the company has a paid policy that is still in force; `policy_id` is that policy. `40025`, on production only, when that unified national number belongs to another of your companies; `company_id` is that company.

message.example: This company has an active policy (123), so its details cannot be changed.

company_id.description: On `40025`, the company that already holds the unified national number.

40026.summary: The company has an active policy

value.message: This company has an active policy (123), so its details cannot be changed.

40025.summary: Production only: the unified national number is taken

value.message: That unified national number is already registered as company 123.

post.description: Cancel a policy for a company

get.description: The company's employee list as last saved.

put.description: Replaces the company's employee list with the one given: who is covered, their dependents, and the class each has picked (`C`, `B`, `A` or `VIP`; the former names `basic`, `standard`, `premium` and `executive` are still accepted and read as those classes). Use it to edit or remove employees after fetching the list. An employee who stays on the list keeps their health declaration. Nothing is priced here; see Get prices from every provider.

400.description: `40024` when the list has more than 250 employees and the company has no policy in force. Dependents do not count.

example.message: SME medical covers up to 250 employees per company; this list has 251.

post.description: Fills the company's employee list with the employees registered under the company, so you start from the company's current headcount instead of typing it in. It replaces the list; edit it afterwards with Save the employees. Every fetched employee starts on the `basic` tier with no dependents.

put.description: The company's health declarations in one call, under one consent for everyone on the employee list, employees and dependents alike. Send an entry only for someone with something to declare, named by their own id as `employee_id`; the consent declares everyone else, so the consent alone is enough when nobody has anything to declare. `consent` must be `true`: by sending it, you confirm they have stated that their answers are true and complete and agreed to share them with the insurance provider. The declarations are kept by id, apart from the employee list, so editing the list leaves them alone; each call replaces them. Someone added to the list afterwards is not covered until the next call, and the company cannot be priced until then.

consent.description: Consent for the whole submission. Must be true.

employees.description: Everyone with something to declare, employees and dependents alike, each with their own answers. Leave out everyone else.

employee_id.description: The id of the person declaring: an employee's nationality_id, iqama_id or border_number, or a dependent's nationality_id or iqama_id. Each person once.

200.description: The company's declarations, keyed by the id of every employee and dependent on the list

answers.description: The answers sent for this person, or null when the consent alone declares them.

400.description: An employee_id is not an employee or a dependent on the company's list. Nothing is stored. employee_ids lists them.

example.message: No employee of this company matches: 9999999999.

post.description: Sends the company a 4-digit verification code by SMS, to send with Get prices from every provider as `otp`. The code is optional on pricing for now. Send the company's own `sponsor_number`: pricing checks the code against the latest one sent for that sponsor number. A code stays valid for the time in `X-OTP-Expires-In` (8 hours) and can price the company again within it; three wrong codes lock it until a new one is sent. One code per phone every three minutes.

phone.description: Saudi mobile number in the form 05XXXXXXXX

sponsor_number.description: The company's sponsor number, as on Create company

429.description: A code was sent to this phone less than three minutes ago

message.example: Verification code was requested recently, try again in 2:41.

503.description: The SMS could not be sent. Try again; the three-minute limit does not apply to a code that was not sent.

message.example: The verification code could not be sent. Please try again in a moment.

post.description: Prices the company's saved employees, at the tiers they picked, with every insurance provider at once. Every employee has to have declared their medical history first. One response, one quote per provider, each with its own `quote_price_id`, its total and price per employee, and the benefits and hospital network of each tier the employees picked. The response `id` is the `quote_request_id`. A quote prices the employees as they stood when it was asked for.

otp.description: Optional for now. The code sent by Send a verification code to this company's sponsor number. When sent, it is checked.

400.description: The company cannot be priced yet: `40020` when it has no employees, `40023` while anyone still has to declare (employee_ids lists them), `40024` when it has more than 250 employees. With `otp`: `40001` when no code was sent for the company's sponsor number, `40012` when the code is wrong, expired, or locked after three wrong tries.

example.message: Every employee has to declare their medical history before the company can be priced. Still to declare: Mary Major.

post.description: Issues the company's policy from one of the quotes it was given: the employees as they were priced, the provider that priced them, and its total as the premium. A company has one policy waiting to be paid for at a time; issuing again before payment replaces it.

quote_price_id.description: The `quote_price_id` of the chosen provider's quote.

redirect_url.description: Where to send the customer once they have paid. `policyID` in it is replaced with the policy's id.

iban.description: The company's Saudi IBAN: SA followed by 22 alphanumeric characters, no spaces. It must be a valid Saudi IBAN (correct check digits), so made-up values are rejected. It is kept on the policy and used by the insurance provider to transfer refunds to the company; the account is never charged.

400.description: The company already has an active policy

message.example: This company already has an active policy (123). Add new employees to it with POST /api/v1/medical/policies/123/additions.

get.description: The hospitals, clinics, pharmacies and other facilities one tier of one provider gives access to, each with its `status` in that tier: `included` for direct access, `referral` when a referral is needed first. Filter by `city` to show one city at a time, or by `search` to match a facility's English or Arabic name. This is the `provider_list_url` the Categories and Quote APIs return with every tier.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Only facilities in this city, as spelled in `cities`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Only facilities whose name contains this text.

cities.description: Every city with a facility in this tier, for a city filter.

code.description: The provider's own code for the facility.

name_ar.example: مجمع نبض المحالة الطبي العام - ابها

422.description: No `category`, or a value that is not one of the four tiers.

get.description: The medical insurance packages one insurance provider offers. Call it once per provider to compare them. Each item in `categories` carries the coverage values and the `category` and `insurance_provider` values to send when issuing policies. There is no price here: a package is priced on the Quote request API, for the company's own employees, once they are saved and have declared.

parameters.name: insurance_provider
parameters.description: Which provider's packages to list. Defaults to `medgulf`.

schema.description: The provider's packages, keyed by category

get.description: The health declaration as a printable PDF, so a company can hand it to the employees who have to fill it in. Pass a `policy_id` and the file carries one page per employee on that policy, with their name, id and package already filled in; leave it out for a single blank form.

parameters.name: policy_id
parameters.description: Produce a page per employee on this policy.

200.description: The form, as a PDF attachment

get.description: The questions of the unified medical declaration form that every insurance company uses, grouped in sections. A question with `choices` takes one of them; one with `options` takes one of those; one with neither takes a free value (a number for weight and height, a date for the expected delivery date). The question text comes in one language per request, picked by the `Accept-Language` header: `ar` for Arabic, English otherwise. The values to send back are the same in both languages. Each key here is a key of `answers` in Submit the declarations.

hospitalizations.question: Any hospital admission during the last 12 months? "Admission: registration as an admitted patient at the hospital until the following morning"

chronic_diseases.question: Have you been diagnosed with any of the following chronic diseases limited to: Autism, listed Benign Tumor (Breast tumors, fibroid uterus, benign prostatic hyperplasia, thyroid goiter and parathyroid glands, liver tumors, colon tumors), Malignant tumors, listed Cardiac diseases (Coronary and valve heart diseases, heart failure, cardiac fibrillation, myocardial infarction, heart clots), Chronic Hepatitis C, Gallstones, Severe Kidney failure (stage 5 requiring dialysis, clearance of less than 15 ml/minute), Urinary tract stones, hernias, Autoimmune diseases (lupus, rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, multiple sclerosis, celiac disease)

hereditary_diseases.question: Have you been diagnosed with any of the following congenital disorder or hereditary diseases limited to: Cerebral palsy, Sickle cell disorder, Thalassemia, hemophilia, metabolic diseases, Hydrocephalus, spinal muscle atrophy, genital malformations, Chromosomal abnormalities, Gaucher's disease, G6PD Deficiency, cystic fibrosis, hemochromatosis, Wilson disease, Polycystic Kidney Disease

eye_diseases.question: Have you been diagnosed with any of the following eye diseases limited to: Cataract, Glaucoma, Retinal diseases

bone_diseases.question: Have you been diagnosed with any of the following bone diseases limited to: Vertebral disc prolapse (moderate or severe), Scoliosis (moderate or severe), Ligament tears, osteoarthritis (moderate or severe)

pregnancy.question: Pregnant females only
options: Current single pregnancy with previous CS delivery

get.description: The texts to show the employer, exactly as returned. Before prices: `declaration_terms`, with one checkbox; that tick is the `consent: true` sent in Submit the declarations. Before payment: `aggregator_agreement` (the aggregator's terms and conditions) and `consent` (the employer confirms they hold the signed declaration forms), each with its own checkbox, next to the chosen insurer's `insurance_company_agreement` link from its quote. `license` is the aggregator's Insurance Authority licence number. `privacy_policy` is a link to Yasmina's privacy policy. `service_provider_logo`, `insurance_authority_logo_dark` and `insurance_authority_logo_white` are links to the aggregator's logo and the Insurance Authority logo (dark for light backgrounds, white for dark ones), to show with the licence number. One language per request, picked by the `Accept-Language` header: `ar` for Arabic, English otherwise.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: `ar` for Arabic. Anything else, or no header, returns English.

200.description: The texts, in the language asked for, and the logos

consent.description: Shown before payment, with its own checkbox: the employer confirms they hold the signed declaration forms.

declaration_terms.description: Shown before prices, with one checkbox. That tick is the `consent: true` sent in Submit the declarations.

aggregator_agreement.description: The aggregator's terms and conditions. Shown before payment, with its own checkbox.

license.description: The aggregator's Insurance Authority licence number, on its own. Show it as returned.

privacy_policy.description: A link to Yasmina's privacy policy.

service_provider_logo.description: A link to the aggregator's logo. Show it with `license`.

insurance_authority_logo_dark.description: A link to the Insurance Authority logo for light backgrounds. Show it next to the aggregator's logo.

insurance_authority_logo_white.description: A link to the same logo in white, for dark backgrounds.

example.consent: I acknowledge that I have obtained all the health declaration forms, filled in with reference to the entity's employees as they were answered before getting the offers, with their signatures taken and certified with the establishment's stamp. I undertake to keep the health declaration forms and to make them available when needed.
example.declaration_terms:
By continuing with our services, you hereby declare all of the following:

1. I hereby acknowledge that the insured members who were not selected do not need a medical declaration (their medical declaration questions will be answered "No", without stating weight and height).
2. I undertake that I have provided correct information, and I agree to appoint Diamond/Shahin (insurance brokers) as our exclusive insurance broker to negotiate in our name and on our behalf with any insurance company, and to grant Shahin the right to use this information, share it with insurance companies, and inquire about the company's and/or the employees' data.
3. I undertake that all the medical declarations were filled in with reference to the employee concerned, for correct pricing and to ensure access to the required healthcare services. This means:
   a. You confirm that the information in all the medical declarations is correct, that offers will be accepted on the basis of this information, and that the insurance company has the right to contact the hospitals it deals with to collect any medical information needed to assess the risk.
   b. You agree that the insurance company has the right to reject the coverage or the claim in full if any condition existing before the contract date, before enrolment, or before a new member is added during the contract period was not declared.
   c. You confirm that you have read and understood all the points in the medical declaration form, and you agree that if all members are stated to have no medical declarations, all members are in normal health for their age and gender.
   d. Failure to fill in weight and height will lead to the cost of obesity surgery not being covered.
4. As an employer, I declare that I comply with all the requirements of the Insurance Authority, the regulations of the Council of Health Insurance, and the related decisions.
example.aggregator_agreement:
Terms and Conditions

You must have the required legal capacity and the authority to act for an establishment when submitting its application. Provide accurate, current information, protect your login credentials and prevent unauthorised use of your account.

Information and declarations
1. You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide and for having the authority to provide members' data.
2. Complete the required declarations with the individuals concerned, using the approved form and instructions.
3. The Privacy Policy explains how data is processed, and specific consent is requested where it applies.
4. Review the establishment's and members' details, compare the available quotations, select an offer and complete the purchase requirements.
5. Policy issuance is subject to the insurer's acceptance, completion of the requirements and verification of the payment.
6. Receiving a quotation or completing payment does not replace confirmation that the policy was issued and a check of the coverage start date.

"Terms and conditions" means the policies below. They may change from time to time, so please read them carefully.

Conditions of use
1. You must be 18 years old or over, with full legal capacity.
2. Anyone under the age of 18 may use the Shahin platform only with the authorisation of a parent or guardian.
3. You confirm that you are able to commit to these terms and conditions.
4. You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you enter on the Shahin platform.
5. You agree to share your data with the related insurance companies.
6. You are responsible for keeping your username and password safe.
7. As a user, you undertake not to misuse the Shahin platform in any way.

Services
1. Amounts are displayed in Saudi riyals, with the applicable tax and fees shown before payment. Use the payment methods available at checkout.
2. Policy cancellation and refund requests are subject to the policy terms, the applicable rules and the status of the request. Contact customer support for the requirements and to track your request.

Applying for an insurance policy
1. The user logs in to the platform.
2. The user chooses the type of insurance.
3. The user confirms the payment.
4. Finally, the user can issue the insurance policy and print it directly.

Use of the platform and responsibilities
Use the platform lawfully. Do not access another person's account, disrupt the service or misuse it. The insurer provides coverage under its policy, and Shahin remains responsible for the obligations that apply to its role. These terms do not exclude obligations that cannot lawfully be excluded.

Content and trademarks
1. Content and trademarks remain the property of their owners or authorised licensees. Do not use them in a way that infringes the applicable rights or laws. Displaying an insurer's trademark does not transfer its ownership to Shahin.
2. We make every effort to protect our website from hacking and viruses.

Permissions
1. By using our website, you authorise Shahin to handle your data.
2. By using the website, you also enable Shahin to share this data with the competent authorities.

Contact
For enquiries and to follow up on complaints, use the Contact Us page, call 8002440399 or email info@shahin.com.sa.

get.description: One policy, with everything needed to take payment: its `price`, `pending_declarations` naming anyone who still has to declare, and `payment_link` once nobody does. The link is a fresh signed URL on every read, valid 15 minutes, and null while the policy cannot be paid for or once it is issued.

post.description: Cancels the whole policy: cover ends for every employee and dependent on it. It cannot remove a single employee.

parameters.name: policyId
parameters.description: The id field returned from policies API's

cancellation_document.description: Optional supporting document explaining why the policy is cancelled.

403.description: This client may not delete the policy

post.description: Adds the people on the company employee list who are not on this paid policy yet: new employees with their dependents, and new dependents of employees already covered. Everyone joining must have declared first. They are priced by the insurer of the policy for the days from today to the last day of the policy, and the response carries a payment link. Once paid they join this same policy. Calling again before payment replaces the unpaid addition. Removals are not supported yet.

parameters.name: policyId
parameters.description: The id of the paid policy

201.description: The addition, waiting to be paid

400.description: `40023` when someone joining has not declared yet (employee_ids lists them), `40027` when the policy is unpaid, cancelled or expired, `40028` when nobody on the list is new.

example.message: Everyone joining the policy has to declare their medical history first. Still to declare: Sam New, Sara New.

insurance_provider.description: The insurer of the policy, which prices the addition

starts_on.description: The first day the new people are covered: the day the addition was priced

ends_on.description: The last day of the policy

days.description: Days from starts_on to ends_on, both included

category.description: The tier. A dependent is covered under the tier of the employee they are listed beneath

price.description: What this person costs for the days covered. Dependents are not charged separately

members.description: Everyone joining: new employees, their dependents, and new dependents of employees already covered

payment_link.description: Where the company pays for the addition. Null once it is paid

Network.description: The network of facilities a tier gives access to.

name.description: The provider's own name for this tier's network.

total.description: How many facilities are in it, included or by referral.

provider_list_url.description: The Networks API call that lists the facilities, or null when we hold no list for this provider yet.

weight.description: Weight in kilograms. Optional; without weight and height the cost of obesity surgery is not covered.

hospitalizations.description: Any hospital admission during the last 12 months.

chronic_diseases.description: Diagnosed with one of the chronic diseases the form lists.

hereditary_diseases.description: Diagnosed with one of the congenital or hereditary diseases the form lists.

eye_diseases.description: Diagnosed with one of the eye diseases the form lists.

bone_diseases.description: Diagnosed with one of the bone diseases the form lists.

enum: Current single pregnancy with previous CS delivery
pregnancy.description: For a pregnant member only. Leave out otherwise.

expected_delivery_date.description: For a pregnant member only, as YYYY-MM-DD.

MedicalFormAnswers.description: One person's answers to the unified medical declaration form, keyed as the Medical form questions API lists them. The five yes/no questions are all answered; weight, height and the pregnancy details are given when they apply.

relationship.description: How the dependent is related to the employee. Parents cannot be added as dependents.

nationality_id.description: Required when nationality_iso is SA. Exactly 10 digits.

iqama_id.description: Required when nationality_iso is not SA. Exactly 10 digits.

date_of_birth.description: Format YYYY-MM-DD. Saudi nationals whose national id starts with 1 give the Hijri (Umm al-Qura) date printed on their id, for example 1409-09-14; everyone else gives a Gregorian date. A dependent can be any age up to 110.

price.description: The premium for everyone on the policy, for a year.

pending_declarations.description: Employees who still have to declare their medical history. Empty once everyone has.

payment_link.description: Where the company pays. A fresh signed link on every read, valid 15 minutes. Null while anyone is in pending_declarations, and once the policy is issued.

provider_policy_id.description: The insurer's policy number, once issued.

policy_url.description: The policy schedule listing every member, once the company has paid. Null before that.

invoice_url.description: The invoice for the premium the company paid, one line per package tier, once the company has paid. Null before that. On sandbox the document is watermarked SANDBOX and is not a tax invoice.

additions.description: People added to the policy after it was paid for, oldest first. At most one is pending

iban.description: The company's IBAN, as sent when issuing the policy. Null if none was sent.

DeclarationAnswers.description: One person's answers to the unified medical declaration form, keyed as the Medical form questions API lists them. The five yes/no questions are all answered; weight, height and the pregnancy details are given when they apply.

weight.description: Weight in kilograms. Optional; without weight and height the cost of obesity surgery is not covered.

hospitalizations.description: Any hospital admission during the last 12 months.

chronic_diseases.description: Diagnosed with one of the chronic diseases the form lists.

hereditary_diseases.description: Diagnosed with one of the congenital or hereditary diseases the form lists.

eye_diseases.description: Diagnosed with one of the eye diseases the form lists.

bone_diseases.description: Diagnosed with one of the bone diseases the form lists.

enum: Current single pregnancy with previous CS delivery
pregnancy.description: For a pregnant member only. Leave out otherwise.

expected_delivery_date.description: For a pregnant member only, as YYYY-MM-DD.

insurance_provider_square_logo.description: The insurance company's logo in a square format.

insurance_company_agreement.description: A link to this insurance company's own terms and conditions. Show it beside this offer.

total_price.description: What the company pays for a year of cover with this provider.

price_per_employee.description: total_price divided by the number of employees.

packages.description: One entry per tier the employees picked, keyed by tier.

price.description: The yearly price per employee on this tier.

benefits.description: What the tier covers: the same coverage values the Categories API returns for it. The Categories API's translations label the keys.

category.description: The tier this employee picked. Every provider sells all four, so the quote request can price it with each of them.

iqama_id.description: For non-Saudis. Exactly 10 digits. A non-Saudi whose iqama is not issued yet sends border_number instead.

border_number.description: For non-Saudis without an iqama yet, in place of iqama_id. Exactly 10 digits.

sponsor_id.description: The employee's sponsor id. Optional. Exactly 10 digits.

is_married.description: Whether the employee is married. Optional.

dependents.description: Family members covered under this employee's policy. They get the same provider and category as the employee. Optional; omit or send an empty array for an employee without dependents.

date_of_birth.description: Format YYYY-MM-DD. Saudi nationals whose national id starts with 1 give the Hijri (Umm al-Qura) date printed on their id, for example 1409-09-14; everyone else gives a Gregorian date. Employees must be between 18 and 110 years old.

health_declaration.description: The employee's declaration, on the employees of a quote request and a policy. Set through Submit the declarations; ignored when sent in.
